answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 45923 Country: United Kingdom Title: Dream Interpretation Question: I saw a dream that I am visiting different parts of Masjid al-Haram with my friend. I meet my father as well. Masjid is under renovation. Its floor is cemented and marbles has to be put on it. Its walls are also under renovation. Even Ka'ba first looked as an empty rectangle iron frame. Then it looked as empty cuboids iron frame with Hajr Aswad at its place. After visit we came out of Masjid. Then I desire to go to Medina and its route is shown. Then dream finished. Some days later I saw another dream that I am standing at the roof of Masjid Haram. When I look at the courtyard then I see that lots of water is flowing in it. Also lots of water is coming at roof as well where I am. Please guide me about these dreams. Also I read in Tabeerur Roya that a person will be safe from worldly disasters if he finds himself in Haram of Ka'ba. I have to file an appeal in court about a decision against me. Do these dreams indicate win of it? Please guide me about it as well. Answer ID: 45923 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 909/709/H=1434) Ma-shaAllah, both the dreams are nice. In-shaAllah, you shall be honoured with hajj, Umrah and visits to the holy places. Also you shall have the blessings of wahy and following sunnah. We could not get any other indication even to succeed in the case. Think over your matters and seek the advice of your near ones who are expert in this field. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
